name: HAZOP (Hazard and Operability Study)
description: A structured, systematic technique for identifying potential hazards in process systems by examining deviations from design intent using guide words (e.g., MORE, LESS, NO). Team-based expert review.
reputation: Gold standard for process safety analysis in chemical, oil/gas, and nuclear industries; IEC 61882 standard.
notes: Time-intensive; quality depends on team expertise; must be re-done when design changes.
